test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

She prefers **to stay at home than go out. **

options.text: to staying home than going out
Staying at home to going out
to stay at home to going out

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence compares two actions: staying at home and going out. The correct structure for such comparisons is "**Staying at home to going out**."
 
• Option 3 is grammatically correct and ensures clarity in comparison.
 
• Options 1, 2, and 4 either use incorrect grammatical structures or fail to convey the intended meaning properly.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She prefers staying at home to going out."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Staying at home**" is the correct gerund form for the first action.
 
• "**to going out**" is the appropriate preposition and gerund combination for the comparison.
 
• Avoid using "**rather**" in this sentence as it disrupts the grammatical structure of the comparison.
 
• The sentence must maintain parallelism between the two actions being compared.
